offering_description.value: Sells apparel, jewelry, beauty, home and other consumer goods to individual shoppers through televised shopping networks and online sites. Products are sourced from brands and vendors and delivered directly to customers.

primary_products.value: apparel; jewelry; beauty products; home goods; consumer electronics

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying through TV shopping and websites

end_markets.value: consumer retail; apparel; jewelry; beauty; home furnishings

revenue_model.value: product sales: consumer merchandise sold through television, online and mobile channels

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys merchandise from vendors and sells it to consumers; brand owner: develops and markets its own home and lifestyle brands sold to consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, Italy and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: television and online shopping networks, online home and lifestyle brands, and related consumer goods

distribution_channels.value: online: company websites and mobile apps; other: televised shopping networks broadcast in several countries

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal consumer protection, advertising and trade rules apply to retail sales

notes: Portfolio changes, including the status of Zulily and other brands, may have shifted and are not fully certain.
